description: Skips (skipped: true), moves (starts_at and ends_at) or changes the message of one occurrence of a repeating maintenance window, leaving the others as they are; restore: true undoes it. Free.

message.description: What visitors are told about this occurrence instead of the series' message.

occurrence_at.description: The occurrence's start as the series gives it: occurrence_at from next_occurrences or occurrence_changes.

restore.description: true undoes every change to this occurrence.

skipped.description: true skips this occurrence: no maintenance then, and its status pages' subscribers hear it is cancelled if they were told about it.

starts_at.description: Moves this occurrence: its new start, with ends_at.

name: change_maintenance_occurrence
title: Skip or move one occurrence
